task:
Anglojęzyczny magazyn dla uczniów organizuje konkurs na **opowiadanie**. Opowiadanie musi zaczynać się od zdania:

**„When I opened the door, I couldn't believe my eyes.”**

- opisz, gdzie i kiedy to się działo,
- opisz, co zobaczyłeś i co zrobiłeś,
- napisz, jak się skończyło i co czułeś.
model:
When I opened the door, I couldn't believe my eyes. My small kitchen was full of balloons, and twenty people were standing in it, smiling at me.

It was my thirtieth birthday, but I had decided not to celebrate. I had a lot of work and I was feeling a bit lonely, because my best friend had just moved to Berlin. I had spent the whole evening at the office, and I was exhausted.

"Surprise!" everyone shouted. Then I saw her – my best friend, holding a huge chocolate cake. She had flown from Germany just for one night! My sister had organised everything and had given her my spare key.

I laughed and cried at the same time. We danced and talked until three in the morning. In the end, it was the best birthday I have ever had.
checklist: Opisuję, gdzie i kiedy to się działo.
Używam Past Simple dla zdarzeń, Past Continuous dla tła i Past Perfect dla tego, co było wcześniej.
Mam zwrot akcji (Suddenly / Then I saw...) i zakończenie (In the end...).
Opisuję uczucia mocnymi przymiotnikami (exhausted, delighted, terrified).
Tekst ma 100–150 słów i kilka akapitów.
